items.summary: Recommendation: freeze new discretionary spend, production expansion, and queue creation this cycle. Continue only existing measurement gates, failed-request repair or closure, private-gate controls, and bounded read-only revalidation. Financial evidence is insufficient for investment approval: Amazon reported $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, but all income is in an unattributed aggregate row; site-attributed income is $0. AI usage cost was $887.6686767 for 2026-09-01–2026-09-24 across 4,968 calls, while infrastructure, labor, domain, hosting, and other operating costs are unavailable. No contribution margin, ROI, payback, or reliable cost-to-learn can be calculated. The $4.92 and $887.67 periods also do not match, so subtracting them would be invalid. The portfolio has no configured monthly spend limit, fixed-cost budget, marketing budget, revenue floor, or attribution materiality threshold. Minimum controls needed before additional spend: period-aligned site-level revenue, direct-cost ledger including infrastructure, experiment exposure/outcome linkage, and approved budget limits. Vanity metrics such as 13,599 impressions, 135 clicks, 963 sessions, 15 conversions, 28 ordered items, or 6 shipped items do not support revenue or causal-lift claims.

Handoff: retain the CEO disposition and require finance review before any new discretionary production or growth work. Do not treat the $4.92 aggregate commission as site revenue, and do not claim that AI spend generated returns. Existing measurement must report only period-aligned impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, attributable commission, and directly evidenced costs.

Update: the current financial gate remains blocked for investment decisions. AI usage is measurable, but infrastructure and other operating spend are not supplied; contribution margin and budget exposure therefore remain unknown. Continue failed-request repair or closure without adding finance-related telemetry requests because the available snapshot already identifies the missing measurement boundaries.

Financial disposition remains blocked for new discretionary investment. The available 2026-09-21 Amazon evidence reports $4.92 in an unattributed aggregate row and $0 site-attributed income; AI usage cost is $887.6686767 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-24, with other operating costs unavailable. Continue measurement using only period-aligned impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, site-attributed commission, and directly evidenced incremental costs. Do not claim ROI, contribution margin, payback, or causality.
